h1: Is the Mazda RX-7 FD3S eligible for import to Australia?
secondary_keywords: is the rx-7 eligible for import
intro_copy: The FD is the last of the twin-turbo rotaries and prices reflect it. The important detail most listings skip: the register approval covers the final Series 8 cars only, not the whole 1991 to 2002 production run. Earlier FDs are still importable, but on the 25-year pathway, not this approval. Rotary condition risk also means auction grade matters more on this car than on almost anything else you will look at.

faqs.a: Yes, by one of two routes. The register approval covers the later Series 8 build window. Earlier FD cars are eligible under the 25-year pathway instead.
faqs.q: Is the Mazda RX-7 eligible for import to Australia?

faqs.q: What is an RX-7 Spirit R?

title_tag: Nissan Silvia S15 Import Eligibility Australia | JDM Connect

h1: Is the Nissan Silvia S15 eligible for import to Australia?

intro_copy: The S15 is the last Silvia and the one everybody wants. Australia got a version of it as the 200SX, which complicates the picture, but the JDM Spec-R with the SR20DET, the six-speed and the LSD is a materially different car. Watch the dates carefully here: the register approval window closes earlier than production did, so later cars come in on the 25-year pathway instead. Which route applies changes your costs completely.
